column1: # Generated C functions with a proved rung-3 refinement (ADR 0023, ADR 0029).
# Each row: the generated C module (build/boot/<module>.c), the C function,
# and the Lean file holding its checked-in AST between
# `-- BEGIN GENERATED AST <function>` and `-- END GENERATED AST`.
# build-image.sh fails when the emitted C of any row drifts from its AST.
# Helper rows (l_...) are the scalar functions an export calls.
# Issue #593: the spawn allocator's seven exports and the 31 emitted helpers
# they call, each after the helpers it calls.
